objective: Teach the isolated router to match assignment requirements to public capability descriptions rather than memorize expert identity or coordinator role.

causal_basis.finding: Balanced fixed-identity SFT lowered loss while increasing table selection from 6/14 to 10/14 and did not connect root source routing.

causal_contrast_dataset.causal_intervention: For each unchanged assignment, permute which visible expert_id carries each capability profile and change the target to the ID whose visible profile matches the assignment.

first_rung.coverage: one target identity per causal group

second_rung_if_needed.coverage: all six registry permutations per causal group

decision_rule.if_rung1_passes: Implement and test frozen e33 plus the isolated router in the live split scaffold.
decision_rule.if_rung1_fails_but_improves_at_least_two: Run the predeclared full-contrast ten-update lineage and evaluate only on untouched 38200.
decision_rule.if_rung1_does_not_improve_two_weak_class: Reject causal-contrast SFT without running rung 2 and move to outcome-based router learning.
decision_rule.if_rung2_fails: Reject causal-contrast SFT and move to outcome-based router learning.
decision_rule.promotion_requires: later live end-to-end population acceptance; router screening alone never replaces e33
